∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (k : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.strictDecideP g k)
    (Bool.and
      (Bool.and (Bool.and (Decidable.decide (LE.le.{0} 2 k)) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.isValid g))
        (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.testsDistinct (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.canonIds (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))))
      (Decidable.decide (LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1) (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoFlow g))))

source.code:
/-- The guarded decision agrees with the Boolean conjunction. -/
theorem strictDecideP_def (k : ℕ) : g.strictDecideP k =
    (decide (2 ≤ k) && g.isValid && g.base.testsDistinct g.base.canonIds &&
      decide (k + 1 ≤ g.rhoFlow)) := by
  unfold strictDecideP
  by_cases hk : 2 ≤ k
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    cases hv : g.isValid
    · simp
    · simp only [if_true]
      cases ht : g.base.testsDistinct g.base.canonIds
      · simp
      · simp [hk, rhoFlow]
  · rw [if_neg hk]; simp [hk]
